title: Restore Linux Ctrl+Meta push-to-talk matching
description: The packaged Linux app receives helper KeypressEvent frames but a stored platform-inapplicable push-to-talk shortcut can never match the Linux Ctrl+Meta physical chord. Determine the proprietary preference schema from the shipped bundle without inspecting runtime preferences. Patch the package so absent or invalid Linux PTT data becomes the exact chord consumed by the current matcher; retain a valid user-selected binding. Add behavioral app and helper fd3 delivery witnesses, expose them as Nix checks, and run them only through configured remote builders. Do not deploy, relaunch, alter session/auth, or change Home/CriomOS pins.
design: Use the existing fix/nix-runtime lineage. Treat non-mac keys as Windows VK values and validate the event stream at the helper fd3 contract boundary. Patch only an evidence-backed, stable bundle site; do not add a compatibility path. Keep runtime data private by making the client-side transformation restricted to the shortcut preference field.
acceptance_criteria: A pre-fix failing behavioral helper witness proves controlled left Ctrl plus left Meta press/release produces fd3 KeypressEvent frames; post-fix it passes through a Nix check. A behavioral app witness proves absent or platform-invalid PTT data becomes the exact Linux Ctrl+Meta matcher chord while an existing valid binding remains unchanged; it too is a Nix check. The producer revision is committed and pushed to the portable fix/nix-runtime ref, with no deployment or runtime preference inspection.
notes: Delivered on fix/nix-runtime 11b2ee0a411f89daedbbff5bd22b640f6a1ddb9a. Remote-only Nix patch and runtime checks passed; full 1.6.7 package build passed. Behavioral startup-contract fixture executes the injected patch: absent or {-1:ptt} maps normalize to 162+91, while a valid custom PTT binding remains. No runtime preference/session/auth data was read or changed; no deploy/relaunch. Coverage gap accepted by repair authority: producer cannot safely add a self-contained helper evdev-to-fd3 VM witness around the pinned binary, so no helper source/repo was changed.
